testcase.name: openForRestore isRootedAtSignalBackups is false when parent is named SignalBackups but contains a real SignalBackups subfolder
openForRestore succeeds when given the parent directory
openForRestore returns null for a directory named SignalBackups without expected structure
openForRestore succeeds when given the SignalBackups directory directly
openForRestore isRootedAtSignalBackups is false when given the parent directory
openForRestore returns null for an unrelated directory
openForRestore isRootedAtSignalBackups is true when given the SignalBackups directory directly
